research_scope: Corrections to unsupported Ultimate Finish certainty in skill batch 27 (PQ123-132).

verification_audit.method: Reviewed PQ reward tables and independent acquisition references. Basic-reward listings were not treated as proof of Ultimate Finish dependence. Where evidence did not establish UF as mandatory, the historical true value is superseded with null rather than false.
